description: Sample of 'what the generic kernel station takes', in the hooks style (id = key, input schema required); would live at $AOS_HOME/lib/tools/aos/kernel/requests.json. One id per body key the station judges; every other key of a letter body is forwarded untouched to the next station.

procs_added.description: start new procs; judged by allowed, max_running and limits of kernel.json

queue_wait_ms.description: how long the sender is willing to wait in the queue

output.description: refused here: {applied: false, error: {code, msg}}; let through: the answer is the next station's

procs_started.description: start procs that are on the table; counted against max_running

procs_woken.description: wake sleeping procs; counted against max_running
